tagline: Fuel your mornings, fuel your ambitions.
description: NovaBrew is a premium D2C coffee brand that blends science-backed brewing with bold, expressive branding. We target young urban professionals who treat their morning ritual as a form of self-care.
target_audience: Urban millennials and Gen Z, 22-38, career-driven, aesthetic-conscious, wellness-oriented.
brand_voice: Bold, witty, aspirational but grounded. Never corporate. Uses casual language, occasional humor, and motivational undertones.
image_style: Dark moody photography with warm amber tones. Close-up textures of coffee beans, steam rising from cups, hands wrapped around mugs. Occasional flat-lay product shots. Aesthetic should feel like a high-end magazine editorial meets cozy coffee corner.

mascot.name: Nova
mascot.description: A small astronaut character holding a coffee cup, used in playful posts and stories.

posting_tone_by_platform.Instagram: Visual-first, short punchy captions, heavy emoji use, aesthetic-focused
posting_tone_by_platform.Twitter/X: Witty one-liners, trending hooks, conversational, hot takes on coffee culture
posting_tone_by_platform.LinkedIn: Thought leadership, brand story, professional but still warm and human

logo_description: Minimalist crescent moon shape forming a coffee cup silhouette, in burnt orange on dark background.
